desc: 琥珀色桃胶干货模版，突出纯净透质感与泡发炖煮流程
name: 琥珀桃胶泡发炖煮干货款

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规展示干货本色
一秒传达干净透亮的琥珀色干货卖点
放大泡发清洗时杂质难挑的痛点，引出纯净度诉求
代入居家炖煮前的泡发场景，营造自然松弛氛围
用微距证明干货晶莹透亮的本体质感
讲清泡发到炖煮的步骤结构，消除不会做的疑虑
以空白证明位降风险，不编造任何资质
收口促单，暖色氛围承接整组视觉

style.backgroundSystem: seamless oat-milk plaster sweep #F4EEE1 for pack, pain-point and info shots; deep amber brown panel #7A4A21 for accent, macro and closing shots; pale honed stone slab #DDD2BE for scene and trust shots; no rustic wood planks
style.iconSystem: minimal thin-line infographic elements and blank proof placeholders in the burnt-copper accent #C05A28 only
style.lightingSystem: soft directional daylight with a gentle warm cast, front or right-side key, soft contact shadows, controlled warm highlights on the gum surface
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm tonic-ingredient food commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of oat-milk white #F4EEE1, pale stone beige #DDD2BE, deep amber brown #7A4A21 and one burnt-copper accent #C05A28; soft directional daylight with a gentle warm cast and soft contact shadows; matte oat-milk plaster sweeps and pale honed stone slabs as surfaces with clear glass dishes; modern geometric sans-serif with generous margins; minimal thin-line infographic elements in the burnt-copper accent only; the dry gum pieces always rendered clean, translucent and amber-toned at a stable scale; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: the dry gum pieces are always rendered clean, translucent and amber-toned; stable warm product scale; hero presented in a shallow clear glass dish
style.surfaceSystem: matte oat-milk plaster sweeps and pale honed stone slabs; clear glass and shallow clear dishes only; no bamboo, rattan, linen or rice-paper surfaces
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif with generous margins
